title: Cheese is in beta
body: We're still polishing Cheese. On top of the {n} credits your plan gives you each month (reset on the 1st), these earn you extra credits during the beta.
bodyNoPlan: We're still polishing Cheese. On top of your plan's credits, these earn you extra credits during the beta.
inviteRule: Paid when your friend first accepts a delivery; your friend also gets up to {n} credits
lifetime: Reward credits last 12 months from when they're issued and are used after the month's plan credits run out.
